title: FACET Policy Record
description: Schema for a FACET policy record (FACET specification, Appendix A.2).

id.description: Canonical policy ID in the form policy/<domain>/<name> (lowercase kebab-case).

summary.description: Human-readable description of what this policy mandates and why.

regulatory_basis.description: Optional reference to the regulation, standard, or internal directive that mandates this policy (e.g. 'GDPR Art. 17', 'SOC 2 CC6.1').

decision_records.description: References to ADR or other decision records that motivated this policy.

clauses.description: Normative clauses that constitute this policy. Each clause has a stable ID and a requirement statement.

governs_features.description: Feature IDs (domain/capability/feature) that this policy governs.

governs_domains.description: Domain names (e.g. 'billing', 'catalog') that this policy applies to in their entirety.

compliance_checks.description: Automated or manual checks that verify compliance with this policy.

audit_artifacts.description: Paths or URLs to audit reports, evidence logs, or certification documents.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this record was first created.

requirement.description: The normative requirement text for this clause (MUST/SHALL/SHOULD language preferred).

id.description: Stable identifier for this compliance check.

cadence.description: How often the check is performed (e.g. 'daily', 'quarterly', 'on-deploy').

team.description: Owning team name (matches Conventional Commits scope).

individual.description: Optional email of the individual DRI for this policy.
